issues.title: refactor(frontend): delegate locale buttons to FsusUI
issues.body:
## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

Related: [locale menu cutover #1891](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1891) remains open. This is the explicitly selected partial raw-button increment; it does not meet that issue's menu-kernel acceptance criteria.

## Scope Summary

Delegate the existing locale trigger, both retry occurrences, and dynamic no-href menu-item button branch to the existing public FsusUiButton adapter. Resolve focus through public ButtonInstance.ref. Product-owned content rows inside the public default slots restore trigger/retry spacing and the no-href item copy/status separation and top alignment. A one-track product grid lets the button slot fill the row, and the product menu/item class explicitly clears adjacent Button margins. The product-owned menu-button class uses content-driven height while the existing 44px minimum target is retained for multiline native/English copy. The href anchor retains its direct content children. Preserve the href anchor, original select/retry/open-change payloads, locale presentation source, and all existing menu, keyboard, outside-pointer and controlled-open handlers.

Review only the owned production file and ordinary source WIP. The PR targets a dedicated branch fixed at the requested d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b source base. It does not target master: that branch has diverged and would include unrelated source composition. UI961 local source is c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [ ] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [ ] External naming exception
- Contract impact: compatible

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`
- [ ] Targeted backend tests
- [x] Targeted frontend checks: original complete application local-alias typecheck and full lint, compared before/after; actual failures are recorded below and in the ordinary WIP.

## UI Evidence

- [ ] Screenshots or video attached for UI changes
- [ ] Mobile layout checked
- [ ] Dark mode checked
- [x] Accessibility and reduced-motion impact considered

## Coding Convention

- [x] Formatter/linter run

- [x] Mechanical formatting separated from logic
- [x] `.git-blame-ignore-revs` updated when applicable

- Formatter version: repository lockfile
- Formatter command: npm --prefix src/frontend run lint:full
- Formatter idempotence evidence: none
- Blame-ignore revision: none

## External Naming Exception

- Exceptions manifest: none

## Documentation / Intent

- [x] Ownership/security/performance intent updated

## Compatibility And Risk

- [x] Cross-language coding conventions reviewed
- [x] Document lifecycle updated: stable facts are current; issue handoffs are historical/proposed; generated docs identify their producer
- [x] External wire / ABI / database / third-party names preserved or explicitly adapted
- [x] Public API impact reviewed
- [x] AEDS frame / binary contract impact reviewed
- [x] Database migration impact reviewed
- [x] Security, auth, moderation, PoW, or privacy impact reviewed
- [x] Docs updated or a reason is recorded below
- [x] Known limitations updated if applicable

## Performance Claim

- Claim level: none
- Evidence path: none
- Non-goals: performance, menu algorithm migration, locale API/store/navigation cutover, acceptance or release qualification

## Release Note

- Audience: none
- Category: none
- Summary: none

## Generated Output

- Generator source: none
- Generated outputs: none
- Digest/evidence: none
- Automation identity: none

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: draft source review only; no merge, Ready transition, release, publishing or deployment.
- Rollback: omit or revert this bounded source increment if public root/ref/event forwarding or locale interaction continuity regresses.
- Deferred work: complete Dropdown/menu migration, genuine published-package parity, browser/keyboard/ARIA/visual acceptance and canonical control-legality qualification.
- Known limitations: all baseline failures and existing issue HOLDs remain failures/HOLDs. No tests, discovery, product-module execution, browser, native, DB or qualification runs. No frozen artifacts, authority, fixtures, assertions, policies, baselines, generated outputs or dependency locks changed.

## Notes For Reviewers

Public API documentation, document lifecycle registry, AEDS/ABI/database/security authority, TODO and blame-ignore changes are not applicable: no such contract changes or mechanical commit are made. The new ordinary WIP records source progress only, with no qualification authority. Product-owned slot markup, zero row margins and content-driven menu-button height address the reviewed layout P2s; the existing 44px minimum target is retained. The script, public refs, event/ARIA bindings and locale projection are unchanged by that repair. Shared coarse-focus work remains with its separate UI author. Rendered layout/focus/ARIA are not runtime-verified here. Retry explicitly retains its original absence of aria-disabled through public attribute fallthrough. No private DOM queries, selectors, new controller behavior or compatibility fallback are introduced. No complete-issue, runtime-equivalence, visual-conformance or independent-acceptance claim is made.

Final static comparison after the content-driven height repair (real clean UI961 `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3`, unchanged original full configurations):

- Full application `typecheck:local-fsusui -- --application`: exit 2, the original 29 TypeScript diagnostics (Blog 4 / UI 25), identical to both the original base and initial draft.
- Canonical `lint:full`: exit 1, the original 83,667 diagnostic lines, identical to both previous sources; the complete raw log is byte-identical to the original-base log.
- Neither full check reports the owned component. All baseline failures and stale reports remain failures. `git diff --check`: exit 0.
- No tests, discovery, product runtime, browser, native, DB, qualification or frozen-artifact operation was run. The reviewed layout P2s have source repairs only; visual and runtime acceptance remain HOLD. No protected handler, public ref, locale calculation, canonical projection, event/ARIA binding or shared coarse-focus source is changed by this follow-up.

Ordinary WIP: `artifacts/control-migration/r22-locale-button-source-wip.md`. Current local raw logs and complete diagnostic comparisons: `/tmp/r22-locale-height/`; previous slot/margin repair logs remain in `/tmp/r22-locale-layout/`. Earlier logs bound to the initial draft and original base remain in `/tmp/r22-locale-button/`. Static equality does not establish UI acceptance or complete either issue.

UI975 remains a separate dependency. This follow-up keeps the recorded clean UI961 alias, changes only the product menu-button height declaration and ordinary WIP, and does not alter shared UI/focus source. The previously accepted slot and margin repairs are retained. The existing product item rule continues to provide `min-height: 44px` while `.locale-selector__item--button` supplies `height: auto`.

Exact current review range: base `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b` → head `1920bb8bcd9bcc16317c745473a95abe0f2ceb18` (three commits). The height repair is the direct child of accepted slot/margin source `e790387795b050ea1f20c8ac9b96efe1c0219b55`. This follow-up adds exactly one production declaration, `height: auto`, plus the ordinary WIP update. The aggregate PR still changes only the owned component and WIP. Current component blob: `e7a69205123a67e7b8414a0b78b56f6f73762339`.
